# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Do not rush in too deeply!! They no longer care what happens to them!
Yeah. Whatever comes, to protect my $$自由$$...
I will fight!!
Do you still believe such nonsense!?
What did you say!?
Then what is $$自由$$ to you!?
In $$自由$$'s name, people have fought wars again and again, but...
the $$自由$$ they gained often became the driving force behind others' lack of $$自由$$ and countless corpses.
For humans like you, who can only live by clinging to the framework called society...
does true $$自由$$ really exist!?
Can you even answer this question with your own strength!?
Is $$正義$$ not the same?
Wars are begun first by cowards who put their own interests first...
then call themselves $$正義$$!!
The side that wins is rarely blamed, however cruel its acts...
and deceives the people by saying it won because it was $$正義$$!
What!?
There are as many things people believe right...
as there are people who hold those beliefs...
To force what you believe is right onto others...
is already an utterly deranged way of thinking!
There is absolute $$正義$$ in $$この世$$!
Then what standard decides good and evil?
And what is that standard based upon?
Even now, many people are dying because of you!
Do you truly think absolute evil or absolute good exists in $$この世$$!?
Heh. Come to think of it, $$ヨハネ$$ also...
talked about $$人権$$ and rights, did he not?
I did indeed!
Then you say other animals and plants, too...
have a right to live!?
In the broadest sense, yes.
All animals and plants are $$罪$$ful beings who cannot live without making other life their nourishment.
You cannot live without taking other animals' lives...
so how can you claim a right to live for them!?
N-no, that is because humans...
So humans are special beings, unlike other animals...
and are permitted to claim rights, is that it?
N-no, let me rephrase that!
$$人権$$ means that, as humans...
we are guaranteed life, $$自由$$, and $$平等$$ from birth, at the very least...
You mean humans alone possess all of those specially!?
So humans may make other animals into $$ペット$$s, kill them...
and $$自由$$ly destroy their habitats!?
T-that is not what I am saying!?
If you assert rights, then duties exist as well, do they not?
Then what are the duties humans must uphold...
at the very least, as humans!?
T-that is...
Before that, I think we have a minimum duty to uphold as inhabitants of this $$世界$$...
That is how it seems to me.
Y-you...
Since when did you become so quick-witted!?
